_description: Music, sounds and effects volume. 'music': each track uses EITHER 'synth' (a built-in melody in src/game/audio/songs/: "picnic" = upbeat and cozy, "meadow" = slow and warm, "overcast" = slow, gray and wistful, "haze" = sparse and hazy) OR 'file' (an mp3/ogg inside public/, e.g. "assets/audio/into_music.mp3"); music always loops; 'volume' is 0 to 1. 'sounds': recordings used by the game ('volume' 0 to 1, or up to 2 to boost a quiet recording), each with EITHER 'synth' (built-in, see src/game/audio/recordings/: "datacenter", "construction") OR 'file' (a real recording in public/assets/audio/). Looping sounds (data center hum, construction) are trimmed and crossfaded automatically so even a very short file loops smoothly. A sound named like a sound effect ("cough", "step", "open", "close", "read") replaces that built-in effect with the file. Add "clips": true when the file holds many separate sounds in a row (like a series of coughs): the game splits it at the quiet gaps and plays one random piece (max 2.5 s) each time, instead of the whole file. 'sfxVolume' (0 to 1) = small sound effects (pop-up chimes, footsteps, coughs); 0 turns them off. 'alexCoughSeconds' = [min, max]: Alex coughs at a random moment in that range, again and again, while on the map ([0, 0] turns it off).
_usedIn: Simulation page → Start screen, Title screen, Intro slides, the valley (music, data center noise, sound effects)

title._location: Starts after the first click ('Click anywhere to begin') and plays on the opening page. Same song as 'intro', so it keeps playing without restarting when the intro slides begin.

intro._location: Intro slides (the title music crossfades into this). Fades out at '6 months later'.

valley._location: The valley (game map), set by maps/valley.json → music

datacenter._location: The noise pop-up's player and the background hum near the data center (short recording, looped seamlessly)

construction._location: Intro slide 3 (construction): replaces the music for that slide

cough._location: Alex coughing on the map (every alexCoughSeconds) and neighbors coughing as Alex walks past. The file has many coughs; one random cough fit (max 2.5 s) plays each time.
